scope: Rebuilt binaries, not retained original timed executables. All file-backed section addresses/sizes match. analysis_source:
import hashlib,json,struct,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/Users/jasonqin/Documents/GitHub/fprisc');p=Path('/tmp/fpr-copy-code-191');sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
def sections(file):
 b=file.read_bytes();assert struct.unpack_from('<I',b)[0]==0xfeedfacf
 n=struct.unpack_from('<I',b,16)[0];o=32;out={}
 for _ in range(n):
  cmd,size=struct.unpack_from('<II',b,o)
  if cmd==0x19:
   for i in range(struct.unpack_from('<I',b,o+64)[0]):
    x=o+72+i*80;name=b[x:x+16].split(b'\0')[0].decode();seg=b[x+16:x+32].split(b'\0')[0].decode();addr,sz,off=struct.unpack_from('<QQI',b,x+32);flags=struct.unpack_from('<I',b,x+64)[0]
    if (flags&255) not in (1,12,18):out[seg+','+name]=(addr,b[off:off+sz])
  o+=size
 return out
a,b=(sections(p/n/'copy') for n in ['before','after'])
assert a.keys()==b.keys()
rows=[]
for name in a:
 (address,x),(other,y)=a[name],b[name];assert address==other and len(x)==len(y)
 row=dict(section=name,address=address,bytes=len(x),before_sha256=sha(x),after_sha256=sha(y))
 if x!=y:
  if name=='__DATA_CONST,__const':
   assert x.replace(b'fpr-interface-1/g188/',b'fpr-interface-1/g191/')==y
   row['difference']='Interface identity revision g188 -> g191 only'
   row['identity_count']=x.count(b'fpr-interface-1/g188/')
  else:
   assert name=='__TEXT,__text'
   differing=[i for i,(v,w) in enumerate(zip(x,y)) if v!=w];assert len(differing)==1
   row.update(differing_bytes=1,difference='Module attach compatibility check: cmp x8, #188 -> cmp x8, #191',instruction_address=address+(differing[0]//4)*4)
 rows.append(row)
a=(p/'before-disasm.txt').read_text().splitlines();b=(p/'after-disasm.txt').read_text().splitlines();assert len(a)==len(b)
differences=[dict(before=x,after=y) for x,y in zip(a,b) if x!=y];assert len(differences)==1
assert 'cmp\tx8, #0xbc' in differences[0]['before'] and 'cmp\tx8, #0xbf' in differences[0]['after']
record=dict(compiler_sha256=sha((root/'fpr').read_bytes()),baseline_compiler_sha256=sha(Path('/tmp/fpr-before-finite-field-workers-189').read_bytes()),source_sha256=sha((p/'copy.fpr').read_bytes()),probe_sha256=sha((root/'tests/base/scheduler_probe.c').read_bytes()),harness_sha256=sha((root/'tests/check_scheduler_latency.py').read_bytes()),build='Same copy source and runtime, separate empty caches, --harts 4 --with tests/base/scheduler_probe.c --keep',binary_sha256={n:sha((p/n/'copy').read_bytes()) for n in ['before','after']},sections=rows,disassembly_differences=differences,scope='Rebuilt binaries, not retained original timed executables. All file-backed section addresses/sizes match. All executable code matches except unused module attach revision check; all remaining section differences are interface version strings. This weakens compiler code-change attribution, but cannot identify the source of host timing outliers or establish WCET.',analysis_source=Path(__file__).read_text())
(root/'bench/2026-11-05-finite-field-workers-copy-code.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
r=root/'bench/2026-11-05-finite-field-workers-copy-latency.json';d=json.loads(r.read_text());d['measurement_script']=Path('/tmp/check_field_copy_latency_191.py').read_text();r.write_text(json.dumps(d,indent=2)+'\n')
print('Copy code comparison PASS:',len(rows),'file-backed sections; only compiler identity metadata differs')
